headline: Cobalt Systems opens new production line in Austin
body: Cobalt Systems commissioned a new line at its Austin site, adding capacity for existing customers. Management said the expansion was funded from operating cash flow.

headline: Cobalt Systems faces customer complaints over packaging defects
body: Several customers reported damaged goods linked to packaging changes at Cobalt Systems. The company said it is reviewing its packing process.

headline: Cobalt Systems reports record quarterly revenue
body: Cobalt Systems reported revenue growth of 10% year over year, driven by repeat orders. Analysts described the results as ahead of expectations.

headline: Cobalt Systems cuts guidance after margin squeeze
body: Cobalt Systems lowered full-year guidance, citing margin pressure from raw material costs and weaker pricing power.

headline: Cobalt Systems announces layoffs affecting 20% of workforce
body: Cobalt Systems said it will cut 20% of its workforce as part of a cost reduction program. Unions criticized the lack of consultation.

headline: Cobalt Systems appoints new regional sales director
body: Cobalt Systems announced a leadership appointment in its sales organization. The company said the change is part of a planned succession.

headline: Court freezes assets of Cobalt Systems amid insolvency petition
body: A court froze assets of Cobalt Systems after creditors filed an insolvency petition. Operations continue under court supervision.
